definitions.gloss: mounting (of a scroll, painting or calligraphy)
definitions.explanation: Backing a painting or piece of calligraphy with paper and cloth and finishing it as a hanging scroll, folding screen or framed work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{表装|ひょうそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{書|しょ}→〜書：28467_sho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{表装|ひょうそう}し{直|なお}して⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had my grandfather's calligraphy remounted.

examples.japanese: {表装|ひょうそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧や⟦{色|いろ}→色：00849_iro⟧⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧⟦{絵|え}→絵：02613_e⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: The fabric and color of the mounting can greatly change how the same painting looks.

notes:
USAGE:
A craft word. The craftsperson is a {表具師|ひょうぐし}; {表具|ひょうぐ} is a near-synonym used mostly in the trade.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{掛|か}け{軸|じく}→掛け軸：06122_kakejiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{表装|ひょうそう}: the mounting of a hanging scroll
- {表装|ひょうそう}し{直|なお}す: to remount
- {表装|ひょうそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧: to have something mounted

WATCH OUT:
The homophone ⟦{表層|ひょうそう}→表層：21091_hyousou⟧ means "surface layer."
